mission.title: Mixer
mission.description: Test a new batch of the cheat code drug on a Chopper and a Demon Army follower.

npc.say: We've opened the safe for you.
The Demon Army--what fools. Sad imitations...
Come into my house? You're gonna get wrecked, sucker!
You! You're from the Merovingian! You must have his cheat code! Yes, I want it! Kill the others and give it to me!
Yes, master! Since, as you decree, only one may sup of the fruit of thy puissance, hesitate not to crucify me, wretch that I am, and grant it to my more-deserving brother!
Oh great and powerful one, who blesses us by trodding the dust of this sorry earth beneath your feet! We go down on our knees before your beneficence!
Hahahaa! What is Anome to me now? I'll crush them all between my fingers!
There are some things even we find...unnatural.
Something smells...off, human--besides you, I mean.

phase.briefing:
Wonderful. All my other operatives are off on missions requiring actual skill, so it looks like I'm stuck with you for another cheat code test run. Clearly we are doomed before we start, but one must go through the motions, mustn't one--at least until I can have you fired for incompetence.
To speed things up a bit, I'm going to have you test this latest batch of code, again in drug form, on two sets of Exiles at once. I know this greatly complicates things for your ape-like brain, but to keep it as easy as possible, I've chosen the weakest gangs in the city as your test subjects: the Uriah Choppers, and the Tabor Park Demon Army.
But I shouldn't get too far ahead, operative, as I know it bewilders you. Go to our facility and pick up two doses of the cheat code drug from the safe.

enter.say: Got a few strong Exile programs in there, and something...sparkly--in code, at least. That must be the drug.

objective.text: Get the cheat code drug from the safe

done.say:
Time to force-feed those to more poor bastards!
Given the low success rates we've seen with experimental codes, it's a good thing that Flood doesn't consider you worthy test subject material...

phase.briefing: You will first find a suitable Chopper. There should be several to choose from at the indicated location. Kill all but one, administer the drug to the survivor, and report back to me. You will most likely not see immediate results, so don't dawdle.

enter.say: I feel sorry for those Choppers right now. But a Merv's gotta do what a Merv's gotta do to keep the boss-man happy and us in the red.

objective.text: Kill all but one of the Choppers

done.say: My scanner shows just one left. Guess what he's getting for lunch? Fresh-baked cheat code!

objective.text: Give the drug to Chopper Joy Rider

talk.say: Yes! Give me the code! Give me the power! Haha! I always told the others I'd surpass them--now they'll know!

done.say: Ugh... No! The pain is nothing--nothing, compared to the power I will gain! Ahaha!
That guy was a little too willing to take the stuff, if you ask me. Flood better keep a close eye on him.

near.say: Now look what you've done; I just dusted in here!
You! You're from the Merovingian! You must have his cheat code! Yes, I want it! Kill the others and give it to me!

phase.briefing:
You're doing surprisingly well so far, {player}. I don't mean that as a compliment; I'm simply surprised that you haven't screwed something up yet.
You'll probably manage it in this next stage: go to Tabor Park, isolate a Demon Army follower, give them the drug, and report.
That was four steps all at once. I realize that was straining things; I can repeat it more slowly and in monosyllables for you, if necessary.

enter.say:
I've got four steps Flood can follow to kiss my--
Oh, yeah, I'm on it. Hmm... A few Exile programs in there; they match the known Demon Army profile.

objective.text: Kill one of the Demon Army followers

done.say: Well, he was asking for it.

objective.text: Give the drug to the other Demon Army follower

talk.say: I am humbled by your miraculous benediction, lordship! I will not fail to make myself worthy of this incomprehensible miracle you carry!

done.say: The room...whirls about me! Enlightenment! I open myself to receive you!
Ho-kay! That was a little too weird. Get away from that nut and report in to Flood.

near.say: Our savior! We are not worthy of this great boon you bring us, but we shall do our best, and follow your teachings, oh master!
Our savior! We are not worthy of this great boon you bring us, but we shall do our best, and follow your teachings, oh master!

Wow. I knew those Demon Army guys were kind of cultish, but this is taking things a bit far!
Uhhh... Man, there's no real nice way to go about this. I say just kill the ugly one.

phase.briefing:
Very well, operative; here is where we see whether or not you've frittered away my time with yet another failure.
We have brought the two subjects together for observation. Examine them and report your findings.

enter.say: I'm picking up some totally whack code in there, {player}. I'm serious; it looks like someone ran every single Japanese kanji, katakana, and hiragana through a bright-green blender, set on "frappe."

talk.say: The power...fills me! Not yet, no... But soon, I'll blast my enemies like a nuclear holocaust!

done.say: I'm...not actually reading any heightened power levels off that guy. I think it's gonna be a while before he nukes anything.

talk.say: Truly, you work in mysterious ways, my master. I dedicate the life you have given me to your calling, though in my still-ignorant state I see only the beginning of its glorious path.

done.say: Cool. Keep this up and you can start a cult of your own. I hear that's how you can really make some easy dough.

near.say: Uh... What? Which one's which? Am I imagining things, or did they swap body sizes? And...parts?

mission.finish:
I'm not actually certain you've failed this time, {player}, but just to err on the safe side, I think I'll call it another loss for you.
These codes we synthesized from Beirn's mutated bloodstream appear to be recompiling RSIs rather than granting raw power such as Unlimit received. Initially disappointing, but I imagine we still may have some use for--
But why am I wasting my voice on you, operative? You can't possibly understand any of this. Fret not; I'll soon find another menial task for you, I'm sure.
